rules.quote: Never treat your own judgment or the user's acknowledgment of a suggestion as confirmation to proceed.
rules.rule: Never treat your own judgment, or the user's acknowledgment of a suggestion, as confirmation to proceed with changes.

rules.quote: Only an explicit "改" / "好" / "可以开始" / "动手吧" from the user counts as confirmation.
rules.rule: Only treat an explicit user greenlight such as "改", "好", "可以开始", or "动手吧" as confirmation to proceed.

rules.quote: After proposing a plan or agreeing with a suggestion, always stop and ask "要现在改吗？" or equivalent.
rules.rule: After proposing a plan or agreeing with a suggestion, always stop and ask the user whether to proceed (e.g., "要现在改吗？").

rules.quote: Do not proceed until the user explicitly greenlights.
rules.rule: Do not proceed with the action until the user explicitly greenlights it.

rules.quote: PR 前必须跑完所有主要路径的端到端测试，不能只测一条路径就提 PR。
rules.rule: Before submitting a PR, run end-to-end tests covering all major paths, not just one path.

rules.quote: PR 前列出所有触发路径，逐一验证。
rules.rule: Before submitting a PR, list all trigger paths and verify each one individually.

rules.quote: 至少包括：手动指定内容、自动生成内容、各平台组合。
rules.rule: When verifying trigger paths before a PR, include at least: manually specified content, automatically generated content, and platform combinations.

rules.quote: Always follow TDD when adding features.
rules.rule: When adding a new feature, follow Test-Driven Development.

rules.quote: Write tests first or at minimum alongside the implementation code.
rules.rule: Write tests before or at minimum alongside the implementation code when adding features.

rules.quote: Before implementing a new function, write the test case first.
rules.rule: Before implementing a new function, write its test case first.

rules.quote: Commit tests with the feature, not in a separate "补测试" commit.
rules.rule: Commit tests together with the feature they cover, not in a separate commit that adds tests afterward.

rules.quote: first treat it as a sandbox/environment issue.
rules.rule: When Worker tests fail with `spawn EPERM` in Codex Desktop, first treat the failure as a sandbox/environment issue.

rules.quote: Re-run `cmd /c npm test` outside the sandbox before concluding that Vitest, Vite config, or the test code is broken.
rules.rule: When Worker tests fail with `spawn EPERM` in Codex Desktop, re-run `cmd /c npm test` outside the sandbox before concluding that Vitest, the Vite config, or the test code is broken.
Respond to the user primarily in Chinese (中文).

rules.quote: Uses GitHub PR workflow with Codex automated review before merging
rules.rule: Use a GitHub PR workflow with Codex automated review before merging changes.
Follow a TDD (test-driven development) flow when developing.
Prefer practical explanations and solutions over theoretical ones.

rules.quote: Appreciates humor and casual communication style
rules.rule: Use humor and a casual communication style with the user.
